info.name: BatBliz Ball Event API
info.description: Collection for testing Ball Event API endpoints with real-time Socket.IO integration

request.description: Get paginated list of all ball events with optional filters
Get a specific ball event by its ID
Get all ball events for a specific match
Get all ball events for a specific innings

body.raw:

  "bowlerId": {{bowlerId}},
  "nonStrikerId": {{nonStrikerId}},

request.description: Create a normal ball event (single run). Triggers real-time Socket.IO event.

{
  "matchId": {{matchId}},
